Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, portables, classrooms, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessments covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term needs into capital planning (Sections I, J, L; detailed cost estimates and assessments for all schools).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed 7-year enrollment projections with methodology; capacity utilization data by site and classroom with square footage and student counts; links capacity analysis to specific facility actions including replacement of portables and new construction; discusses consolidation and adaptive uses (Sections G, H, L).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed educational specifications including 21st Century learning environments, technology integration, STEM labs, flexible classrooms, and program-specific facility needs; facility projects directly respond to educational goals (Sections A, D, J, L).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces such as playgrounds, fields, and parking; identifies strategies for improvement including shade structures, gardens, and sustainable landscaping; mentions outdoor learning and wellness connections at some sites but lacks districtwide greening data and climate resilience framing (Sections L, J).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related facility issues indirectly through energy efficiency and safety upgrades but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive mitigation strategies; no districtwide climate resilience theme evident (no explicit climate risk assessment or mitigation detailed).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as HVAC upgrades, lighting improvements, and solar panels; references energy use data and aligns with some state requirements; mentions energy resilience goals but lacks comprehensive resilience strategies like microgrids or full electrification plans (Sections I, J, L).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, prioritization framework, and multiple funding sources including bonds, state grants, and developer fees; includes escalation assumptions and contingencies; aligns financial capacity with educational priorities and facility needs (Section K).
